snippet.title: HOLY Intentions Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
HOLY Intentions is a fast-paced FPS set on a divine scale.

You are the Crusader, chosen to punish the wicked.

Armed with a Dragon and devastating holy powers, tear apart an evil cult that controls the entire world.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/4008930/HOLY_Intentions/
